newsitem.title: USA: Stocks fall after strong July jobs report.
newsitem.headline: Stocks fall after strong July jobs report.

text.p: Stocks fell along with the bond market Friday after reports of the lowest unemployment rate in 24 years and surprisingly strong manufacturing activity revived fears that inflation was creeping higher.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average fell 30.43 points to close at 8,192.18 after earlier falling 120 points. In the broader market, declining issues led advances by almost a 2-1 margin on volume of about 500 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange. The Nasdaq index ended marginally higher, up 0.52 point at 1,594.33.
